content: Godot stable GD0001 requires partial GodotObject classes because source generators implement engine bindings. Node readiness occurs children before parent and reentry does not automatically rerun Ready. Active scene tree is not thread-safe. C# signals document automatic-disconnection exceptions for captured lambdas/custom signals. These conflict with blindly copied generated-code and async rules; prove scoped adaptations in a real scene. Sources: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/diagnostics/GD0001.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_node.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/performance/thread_safe_apis.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/c_sharp_signals.html
